lip_mm.why: the lip's thickness (a half round): not resolved in the side view's outline

bead_mm.why: the foot ring's rounded bottom edge

crease_mm.why: the corner between the foot's outer face and the underside

roll_mm.why: the glaze's thick lower edge, rounding the corner between underside and wall

groove_fillet_mm.why: the groove under the lip band, rounded (its sharpness is not resolved)

foot_width_mm.why: the foot ring's width at its bottom (its inner face is hidden)

density_g_cm3.why: bulk density of the fired body with its glaze (iron-rich stoneware, a few % porosity: 2.2-2.4; the glaze ~2.5 is a thin share)

recess_frac.why: the base's underside inside the foot ring, recessed above the foot's bottom by this fraction of the foot's height

floor_fillet_mm.why: the inner wall turns into the floor in a broad curve (the well)

thickness_shape.why: the wall thickens linearly from the lip's thickness at the groove to w_low at the wall's foot; the base under the floor is w_low thick

camera_1937.model: pinhole (tools/lathe.py); principal point at the cropped plate's centre [A]
